dict_daily_AG.json.why: Community AG parameter dictionary. Radiation units differ per community (RE kW-hr/m^2/day, AG MJ/m^2/day, SB W m-2) while T2M is C in all three.

dict_daily_RE.json.why: Community RE parameter dictionary. Radiation units differ per community (RE kW-hr/m^2/day, AG MJ/m^2/day, SB W m-2) while T2M is C in all three.

dict_daily_SB.json.why: Community SB parameter dictionary. Radiation units differ per community (RE kW-hr/m^2/day, AG MJ/m^2/day, SB W m-2) while T2M is C in all three.

error_404_hourly_regional.html.why: hourly/regional does not exist, and it fails as a 19 KB text/html page rather than a JSON API error -- so it must be refused locally or the user sees a wall of markup with no hint the combination is unsupported.

error_422_bbox.json.why: A 1 deg bbox: 422 'Please provide at least a 2 degree range in latitude'. The binding regional constraint is a MINIMUM, not just a maximum.

point_1983_partial.json.why: HTTP 200 that silently OMITS a requested parameter. Radiation starts 1984-01-01, but with a met parameter present POWER returns 200 with only T2M in properties.parameter plus a note in messages[]. A parser keyed on the requested list KeyErrors here.

point_daily_2param.json.why: The baseline point response. Two parameters from two different parents, so header.sources is ['MERRA2','SYN1DEG'] and attributable to neither -- the case that forces family-splitting.

point_hourly_lst.json.why: The same hour in Local Solar Time. Pairs with point_hourly_utc.json to pin the ~7 h phase shift at Boulder -- the silent error POWER's own default produces.

point_hourly_utc.json.why: Hourly solar in UTC. Units are Wh/m^2 (NOT kW-hr/m^2/day), and the Wh/m^2 -> W m-2 conversion is x1, not x3600.

point_monthly_yyyy13.json.why: Monthly keys are YYYYMM and YYYY13 is the ANNUAL MEAN, not a month. Left in, it is a spurious point every 13th step. Also pins that monthly takes year-only dates.

point_solar_2000.json.why: Solar before the transition: header.sources is ['SRB'], not CERES.

point_solar_2001.json.why: Solar after the transition: header.sources is ['SYN1DEG']. With the 2000 fixture this bisects the SRB -> CERES seam to 2001-01-01.

regional_daily_fc.json.why: Regional JSON is a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of cell CENTRES. Used to cross-check the NetCDF raster's georeferencing against a second wire format that must agree cell for cell.

regional_daily_t2m_tileN.nc.why: North tile of a MERRA-2 pair. Its 0.5 deg grid has a node exactly on the lat-40.0 boundary, so it shares an edge row with the south tile.

regional_daily_t2m_tileS.nc.why: South tile. Mosaicking these two must yield 9 rows, not 10.

regional_monthly_t2m.nc.why: The YYYY13 trap on the RASTER path, and the highest-consequence one: 26 bands for 24 months, NETCDF_DIM_time carrying 202013/202113, and NO time#units attribute at all, so there is nothing to CF-decode against.

regional_solar_tileN.nc.why: CERES solar on its native 1.0 deg grid, centred on half-degrees -- so an integer tile boundary falls BETWEEN cells and nothing is duplicated. The counter-example to the MERRA-2 pair, and proof the two families are not co-registered.

regional_solar_tileS.nc.why: South solar tile. Mosaicking with tileN must yield 4 rows and no duplicate.
